title: Koda's Catio
description: A collection of mods that make Minecraft more fun and entertaining for friends and I to play.
body:
This mod pack is a collection of player-requested features I've gathered over my 10+ years of hosting a mostly vanilla server. What's included is farily standard for a "Vanilla+" experience, plus a few extras. It's sole purpose of being published here is an effort to make future updates and changes easier for players, rather than having to pass out new pack files every time and people having to fully reconfigure their instance every time.

Currently, Lanostry's Foxes needs to be enabled within your resource packs to see a larger variety of foxes, as it is not enabled by default. This resource pack is mostly cosmetic, so there isn't an issue if you forget to / don't want to enable it.
